title: Synonymy Case Trace and Decision Blocker Classification (v30)
description: Comprehensive trace of all 19 synonymy development vignettes evaluating why proposals did or did not resolve decisions, mapping each case to exact blocker categories.

wiring_defect_remediation.defect_identified: MultiAgentVerificationPipeline.adjudicate_sync (app/agents/pipeline.py lines 192-200) updated assessment.status to MET upon accepting an LLM proposal, but failed to update assessment.raw_confidence from verified_span.confidence (leaving it at default 0.50).
wiring_defect_remediation.impact: Triggered CalibratedAbstentionGate weakest_link_floor (0.65) and dragged calibrated aggregate confidence below tau=0.85.
wiring_defect_remediation.fix_applied: Updated app/agents/pipeline.py to set assessment.raw_confidence = verified_span.confidence or 0.95.
